meta.title: 2c. Revoke without the lost controller; uninstall preserves data

messages.label: Read selected marker and binding
messages.note: Names from saved config or explicit host arguments.

messages.label: Revoke: remove matching variable
messages.note: No old controller secret or machine required.

messages.label: Request reconciliation if supported
messages.note: Unavailable broker means closure is still pending.

messages.label: Uninstall only: stop / remove runtime
messages.note: Keep volumes, workspace/history and shared settings.

cards.title: Two explicit installer actions
items: Revoke removes only the selected approval; additionally self-revoke if the private credential is still available.
Uninstall revokes first, then tears down only the selected managed runtime. User-selected environment/variable names work for both.

cards.title: Different observable outcomes
items: GitHub marker removal, durable broker closure and old GitHub-token settlement are distinct states. No false success after a partial failure.
A copied old marker cannot reopen a revoked grant. Fresh enrollment needs new identity/credential/challenge; a GitHub read outage denies issuance without fabricating deletion.

cards.title: Protected scope and open evidence
items: Preserve persistent data, shared environment, unrelated variables/secrets and the GitHub App installation by default.

Actual GitHub freshness, deletion/recreation and in-flight token races still need engineering review and hosted proof. This is the approved issue #31/#39/#53 design, not implemented behavior on the code baseline.
